hero.intro: I'm Lance, a fourth-year CS student at UBC pursuing a minor in Data Science. I'm interested in machine learning and in building clean, purposeful software. Outside of coding, you'll spot me staying active in some form: bouldering, hiking, or training for my next marathon.

ui.hint: Click a station to see what's there.
ui.mapTitle: Map of Lance's work and projects, 2024 to 2026

stations.label: EOAS
stations.title: UBC Earth, Ocean and Atmospheric Sciences · Data Analyst
stations.tagline: Cleaned 11 years of ocean data and kept an oceanographic atlas running.
body: I cleaned and validated 11 years of nutrient and CTD (conductivity, temperature, depth) data, making more than 900 corrections. To do it, I audited inconsistent legacy code and adapted a MATLAB quality-control pipeline to handle year-by-year differences.
I wrote automated QC scripts that standardise new data from 2024 onwards against the historical record.
I also maintained the Atlas of Oceanographic Conditions, building the back-end pipelines and plots that compare conditions across the inlets of the Strait of Georgia.

stations.title: Campus Insights
stations.tagline: A query engine and dashboard for exploring UBC data.
body: This is a full-stack app for exploring UBC data, built by a two-person team in Scrum sprints.
It's powered by a custom query engine implemented from an EBNF specification, with the results charted in a React + Vite front end using Chart.js.
I wrote more than 50 Mocha/Chai integration tests, which caught 8 regressions and let us refactor without fear.

stations.label: WildlifeDB
stations.title: WildlifeDB
stations.tagline: A relational database that puts conservation records in one place.
body: This full-stack platform centralises wildlife-management and conservation data for non-technical users on a relational database.
I modelled the ER diagram, normalised the schema to 3NF, and enforced referential integrity with cascading operations, which made the database about 30% faster.
All 10 SQL endpoints are parameterised and sanitise every input, and data retrieval got about 50% faster.

stations.label: Refine
stations.title: Refine · HelloHacks 2024
stations.tagline: AI essay feedback for students, built in 48 hours.
body: This web app gives students personalised essay feedback from GPT-4, and we built it in under 48 hours.
I worked on the prompt engineering behind the feedback, and I prototyped the interface in Figma before building it out with a mentor's guidance.

stations.label: Paper Profit
stations.title: Paper Profit
stations.tagline: A risk-free stock market simulator for learning to invest.
body: This is a risk-free virtual stock market for learning to invest, delivering 9 user stories.
It has a Java Swing GUI and saves and loads portfolios as JSON.
I built it test-first with JUnit to 100% coverage and planned it with a UML class diagram.
